host_boundaries: The host installs the constructed ShaderManager pointer at the verified Renderer global, following the pinned Crayon2 paint harness setup.
pthread_mutex_init/lock/unlock/destroy are serialized single-thread host adapters; contention and Android bionic mutex semantics are not tested.
CanvasProbe vtable slot +208 is populated with a logged host detach callback so native Drawable destruction can return; its app implementation is not recovered here.
Unregister records show the null subscription fast path, which does not call the TLS manager accessor. This is not evidence for subscribed-object unregister behavior.

scope: Synthetic ObjectStroke inputs are sent through the pinned Model/ObjectDrawing/ChineseBrush GLV1/2/3 Drawing route and RTV1 AddPoint. Reuse controls run sequentially in one Drawing/canvas/Pen instance with separate ObjectStroke inputs. Fresh, same-setting and setting-transition cases are included. Renderer ShaderManager is natively constructed and installed at the pinned Renderer global, but this reproduces an explicit host loader prerequisite and is not Android loader/runtime evidence. The mock Canvas detach method and serialized pthread mutex routines are host lifecycle adapters. This validates bounded native saved redraw state behavior, not SDK deserialization, Android thread scheduling, GPU paint, export, or device parity.
